name: Flatcheez 3
source:
Ever since Yuuta's friend Nae-chan went missing at the end of Flatcheez 2, Yuuta tends to isolate himself from the people around him.
Thinking that he is responsible for Nae-chan's disappearance, Yuuta decides to search for her.
However, the search is not a simple one, and he has to overcome several naughty ordeals...!

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01052820.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
自从《Flatcheez 2》结尾，朋友Nae酱失踪后，Yuuta便开始疏远身边的人。
认为自己有责任的他，决定动身寻找Nae酱。
然而，这场寻找并不简单，他必须跨越几场令人脸红的考验……！
